title: Free Day in Baghdad
full_text:
Free Day in Baghdad Today is a free day for you to explore Baghdad at your own pace.
You can revisit your favorite spots in the old city, such as Al-Mutanabbi Street, or spend time in the modern districts like Karrada and Mansour for shopping and experiencing the city’s contemporary lifestyle.
This is also an excellent opportunity to visit any local galleries or museums you may have missed.
